walk.note: full stride cycle, verified as a real alternating gait, no duplicate/broken frames

sit.note: 01 = neutral sit, 02 = looking up. Re-checked against Drive 2026-08-01: 01 unchanged byte-for-byte since the original 2026-07-11 import; 02 was redrawn (new file ID, same pose/framing, minor line-work refinement) -- bottom margin shifted 161px -> 157px, left-edge 248px -> 240px, small enough that only STATE_GROUND_OFFSET['sit-lookup'] in engine.js was retuned (162 -> 157) rather than pixel-shifting the art.

look.note: NOT a front-facing turn pose — body stays in left-facing walking profile, only head/eyes tilt toward camera. Designed as substitutes for walk frames #4 and #7 when she glances mid-stride; 02 (orig. Drive 'Sq 7.png') can also be used standalone as a lightweight 'look at camera' cue.

sleep.note: Re-imported 2026-08-01 as a full sit-to-sleep sequence (replaces the old 3-frame set, which was only the curled/breathing tail end). 01 = neutral sit, same framing as sit_01 -- entry point from the sit baseline; 02 = lowering into a crouch, head dropping, front paws forward (the sit -> lying transition, drawn directly rather than needing a separate gap frame); 03 = fully curled, eyes closed, first settle; 04/05 = curled eyes-closed breathing pair (chest fuller vs. relaxed), alternate for the sleep-deep breathing loop, same role the old 02/03 played. As-imported the 5 frames had wildly inconsistent bottom-of-silhouette margins (146/139/153/217/217px vs. sit_01's 168px) which made her visibly jump upward on the 04/05 breathing frames under the single fixed STATE_GROUND_OFFSET.sleep; all 5 were recentered in-place (vertical shift only, no scaling) to share sit_01's 168px margin exactly so the ground-contact line holds steady across the whole sequence. A second pass the same day fixed a matching horizontal bug: left-edge (nose/whisker) x-position was 166/147/152/242/242px across 01-05, so with the fixed-x sleep container she visibly drifted rightward reaching frames 04/05; frames 02-05 were shifted horizontally in-place (dx = +19/+14/-76/-76px respectively, 01 left as the zero-shift reference since it's the sit-matched entry/exit frame) so all 5 share sleep_01's 166px left edge. A third pass re-pulled frames 4/5 from Drive after the artist corrected them at the source (new file IDs, near-correct framing already: bottom margin 135/130px and left-edge 152/147px, vs. the earlier 217/242px) -- only a small residual shift was needed (dx +14/+19, dy -33/-38) to land exactly on the shared 168/166px reference, replacing the earlier large hand-patched offsets for these two frames. A fourth pass 2026-08-02 re-pulled frames 4/5 again (new file IDs, artist revised the breathing pair a second time; queried Drive and diffed modified-timestamps -- 1/2/3 unchanged since the 2026-08-01 passes, byte-identical to what's already imported, so only 4/5 were re-downloaded/re-keyed) -- as-keyed bbox was left=160/bottom margin=149px (04) and left=160/bottom margin=148px (05), so a small pure-translation shift (dx +6/+6, dy -19/-20) landed both back on the shared 166/168px reference. 01-03 unchanged since 2026-08-01.

stretch.note: 01 = neutral stand -- kept in the file but NOT used by the stretch playback (the behavior is standing-only: she's always already on her feet when it triggers, so entry starts at 02, never 01). 02 = arched-back yawn (still on 4 legs), 03 = full downward stretch eyes open (alert), 04 = full downward stretch eyes closed mouth closed (settled), 05 = same pose small yawn opening, 06 = same pose full wide yawn, 07 = same pose closed again (near-duplicate of 04, the yawn's closing bookend, held briefly as the sequence's last frame). 04-07 added 2026-07-19. Playback as of 2026-07-19: straight through 02->03->04->05->06->07, no reverse -- she settles directly into sit_01 afterward instead of stepping back down to standing.

pounce.note: 01 = coiled crouch/ready, 02 = airborne leap, 03 = landed crouch

catnip.note: This is the POST-catnip reaction animation (01/02 = rolling on her back, alternate; 03 = sprawled settle; 04 = front-facing stare — the only genuinely front-facing frame in the whole asset set). The lead-in 'taking catnip' action (approach/sniff/bite) does not exist yet — known gap, not blocking.

groom.note: Re-imported 2026-08-01 from the new Drive 'Grooming' folder, replacing the old standing 'Paw licking' set entirely. All 3 frames are the seated sit_01 body pose (not standing) with the head/paw grooming -- 01 = eyes open, tongue out, mid-lick; 02 = eyes closed, paw lower, mid-lick; 03 = eyes closed, paw raised higher toward the face. Loop 01->02->03 or similar while seated; unlike the old set this only makes sense from sit, not idle/mid-walk.

tailwag.note: same body as sit_01 throughout, only the tail moves: 01 = curled in (matches sit_01 exactly), 02-04 = tail extended, sweeping through different angles. Only valid overlaid on the sit_01 body pose.

whack.note: Added 2026-08-02, dedicated cursor-whack art (own body pose, distinct from sit/pounce). 01 = standing arched play-bow stretch -- NOT used by the whack behavior, kept in the file for completeness/possible future use only. 02 = low coiled stalking crouch, intent stare, front paw tucked -- the held 'watching the cursor' pose. 03/04/05 = the same low crouch body with the front paw at three stages of a swipe (extended-low, pulled-back, extended-low again, each with drawn motion lines) -- forms a natural repeating batting loop when cycled 03->04->05->03. 02-05 recentered vertically (dy up to +/-13px) to share a single 199px ground margin -- as-imported they ranged 186-212px, which would've read as a small vertical jitter under the single fixed STATE_GROUND_OFFSET.whack; left-edge was deliberately left untouched across frames since the horizontal spread (left=0/128/208) is the actual swipe motion, not misalignment.

blink.note: duplicate of sit_01 with eyes closed. Alternate sit_01 <-> sit_blink for a blink loop while seated. Not part of the sit[] sequence array -- a toggle, not a pose index.

bowl.note: two states (empty/full), not a single static prop

cushion.note: Added 2026-08-01, user-provided (not from the Drive 'Cat Sq' folder like everything else): C:\Users\thear\Downloads\ChatGPT Image Aug 1, 2026, 10_10_41 PM.png, a round tufted cushion in side profile, originally 1536x1024 on a pure-black backdrop. Unlike the cat's bright art on black, this cushion's own dark charcoal fabric (RGB ~30-55) sits close in tone to the black backdrop, so the usual max(R,G,B)<=60 threshold would've eaten into the fabric via border flood-fill; keyed instead with a tight low=8/high=16 ramp (the actual background-to-content transition here is a ~2-3px anti-aliased ramp, confirmed by sampling) which cleanly preserved the fabric with no holes. Cropped to content bbox (source bbox was 83,481-1452,719 within the 1536x1024 canvas) rather than kept at full canvas like the bowl props, since this is a single static image with no sibling frame it needs to stay pixel-aligned with. Displayed in renderer/index.html as a plain , not loaded through the manifest/ASSETS pipeline like the animated states.

reference.reason: 6 loose files in Drive root (Sq 1.png..Sq 6.png) — redundant walk-pose reference sheet, not a distinct pose. Excluded from production manifest per direction; kept only in the source tree.

look.note: orig. Drive filenames: 1.png = 'Sq 4.png', 2.png = 'Sq 7.png' (already renamed to 1/2 in an earlier session)

sleep.note2: Full 5-file re-import 2026-08-01: Drive replaced files 1-3 with new art (a real sit->lying->curl sequence) and added 4/5 as the breathing-loop pair, superseding the old 3-frame set entirely. Keyed via border flood-fill (max(R,G,B) <= 60 walked in from the image edges) rather than a blanket per-pixel threshold, since these frames have genuine near-black shading (nose/ear/mouth) that a blanket threshold would incorrectly punch transparent. 4/5 re-pulled again 2026-08-02 (new file IDs in Drive, 1-3 confirmed unchanged by file ID/modified-timestamp diff), same keying process, re-aligned to the same 166/168px left/bottom-margin reference.

stretch.note2: 4-7 added 2026-07-19, source Drive 'Stretch' folder files 4.png-7.png. Arrived with solid black (0,0,0) backgrounds despite being in the 'transparent' subfolder -- keyed via connected-component flood-fill (max(R,G,B) <= 60 => transparent, all components not just border-touching, since nothing in this art is legitimately near-black) before landing here.
